about: Text for the flash site, one entry per build in boards/. tools/make-flash-site.py adds the target, the image and its SHA-256. Keep the pins equal to main/scrl_board.h.

nanoh2-minican.name: M5Stack NanoH2 + Unit Mini CAN
nanoh2-minican.can: TWAI, Grove port: TX GPIO2, RX GPIO1
notes: TX = GPIO2, RX = GPIO1. This wiring passed the full validation in the car on a Unit Mini CAN with the Grove cable (2026-11-20).
With another cable or another unit, measure continuity first: GPIO2 must go to TXD of the transceiver. For the other wiring, build the firmware with the other pin choice (see the firmware README).
After the first flash, stay in Listen-Only until frames arrive.

m5stack-atom.name: M5Stack ATOM Lite + ATOMIC CAN Base
notes: Pins as in hypery. If no frames arrive, try the TX/RX swapped build.

m5stack-atom-matrix.name: M5Stack ATOM Matrix + ATOMIC CAN Base
notes: The front button (GPIO39) opens the pairing window.

m5stack-atom-swap-pins.name: M5Stack ATOM Lite + ATOMIC CAN Base, TX/RX swapped
notes: For an ATOMIC CAN Base that is wired the other way round.

esp32-generic-twai-sniffer.name: ESP32 DevKit + SN65HVD230, listen only
notes: This build never sends. Use it to watch the bus.

esp32-mcp2515.name: ESP32 + MCP2515 module
esp32-mcp2515.can: MCP2515: SCK 18, MISO 19, MOSI 23, CS 5, 8 MHz crystal
notes: For a module with a 16 MHz crystal, build the firmware with the crystal option. A wrong crystal gives a wrong bit rate.

ttgo-tdisplay.name: TTGO T-Display + MCP2515
ttgo-tdisplay.can: MCP2515: SCK 33, MISO 32, MOSI 25, CS 26, 8 MHz crystal
notes: MISO needs a 5 V to 3.3 V divider, as in hypery. The display stays off.

lilygo-t2can.name: LilyGO T-2CAN, can0 (CAN B terminal)
notes: Vehicle CAN on the CAN B terminal. The MCP2515 (CAN A) stays off the bus.

lilygo-t2can-can1.name: LilyGO T-2CAN, can1 (CAN A terminal)
lilygo-t2can-can1.can: MCP2515: SPI, INT 8, RST 9, 16 MHz crystal
notes: Vehicle CAN on the CAN A terminal, as in hypery's wiring table.

lilygo-t2can-fd.name: LilyGO T-2CAN FD, can0 (CAN B terminal)
notes: Vehicle CAN on the CAN B terminal. The MCP2518FD (CAN A) stays off the bus.

lilygo-t2can-fd-can1.name: LilyGO T-2CAN FD, can1 (CAN A terminal)
notes: Vehicle CAN on the CAN A terminal. The board measures the crystal before it goes on the bus.
